sentences.text: This is the second application seeking for suspension of sentence and grant of bail filed on behalf of appellant-accused Anand @Andu, who has been convicted under Section 376(3) of the Indian Penal Code and Section 3/4 of the Protection of Children from Sexual Offences Act, 2012 and sentenced to undergo R.I. for 20 years and to pay fine of Rs.5,000/- respectively with default stipulations as mentioned in the impugned judgment of conviction and order of sentence dated 02.03.2020 passed by the Special Judge, Scheduled Castes and Scheduled Tribes (Prevention of Atrocities) Act, District Sidhi in Special Sessions Case No.37 of 2019.

sentences.text: 3. The case of the prosecution is that on 19.04.2019 at about 12.30 in the afternoon when the prosecutrix went to attend the nature's call in the forest, the appellant came over there, caught hold her and committed rape with her.
At that time her grandfather also came there, seeing him the appellant fled away.
The prosecutrix went home and narrated the incident to her parents.
She went to the police statim Kotwali, Sidhi and lodged the report against the appellant.
Her statement was recorded wherein she alleged against the present appellant for commission of offences as aforementioned.
The appellant was arrested on 20.04.2019.
After trial, the appellant was convicted and sentenced as mentioned above.
4. The application for suspension of sentence and bail has been filed on the ground that the applicant has already undergone the custody period of five years.
There are material contradictions in the statement of the prosecutrix recorded under Sections 161 and 164 Cr.P.C.
There is a serious dispute with respect to the age of the prosecutrix.
There is no mentioning of the fact that the forceful assault was made on the prosecutrix.
The MLC report is also silent about this fact.
There is no likelihood of early hearing of the appeal in near future.
The appellant is in jail since 20.04.2019.
He is ready to abide by all the terms and conditions that may be imposed by this Court while considering the application for suspension of sentence and grant of bail.

sentences.text: Per contra, learned Public Prosecutor has vehemently opposed the contentions stating therein that the prosecutrix was minor at the time of commission of offence.
He has categorically opposed the manner in which the offence has taken place.
The FSL report is found to be positive.
There is no explanation of the same that could be given by the appellant.
Mere minor contradictions and omissions in the statement of the prosecutrix will not entitle the appellant to be released on bail in such a heinous offence.
In view of the aforesaid, he has prayed for rejection of the application.

6. Considering the overall facts and circumstances of the case, the age of the victim coupled with the manner in which the offence has been committed, this Court does not deem it appropriate to allow the application for suspension of sentence and grant of bail.
7. Accordingly, I.A. No.4285 of 2024 is rejected.

(RAVI MALIMATH) (
 CHIEF JUSTICE   LR Anand @ Andu vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 16 April, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/28941575/
